title: Generic MCU normal operation (illustrative)
description: Minimal stand-in application-mode protocol, existing only to demonstrate a fully-specified relatedInterfaces transition into the auto-baud bootloader above.

commands.name: EnterBootloader
commands.description: Requests a jump into the ROM bootloader for firmware update. See relatedInterfaces for exactly what happens next.

responses.name: BootloaderEntryConfirmed
responses.description: Distinct from an ordinary ack -- confirms the device is about to reset into the bootloader, not that it merely accepted the command.

relatedInterfaces.name: Generic MCU serial bootloader (illustrative, sync-byte auto-baud)
relatedInterfaces.returnTrigger: Sending Go with the application's entry address, or a power cycle if that never arrives.
relatedInterfaces.description: 50ms after BootloaderEntryConfirmed, the device resets and starts waiting for the bootloader's own auto-baud sync byte -- an entirely different framing, at whatever new baud rate auto-baud detects, not the 115200 this interface used.
